name: Pöytäpaska
description: Pöytäpaska (Spanish Shitpants) is a Finnish beating game variant where players have face-up and face-down cards on the table in addition to their hand. The goal is to get rid of all cards: hand cards first, then face-up table cards, then face-down cards.
